text:
jon-partnerships: Quick sync — VoltEdge shared a perf/W sweep. Alex posted preliminary CSV. Can we align on what we can publish and timing?
alex-voltedge: Uploaded results here: https://files.voltedge.example/rdw-sweep.csv — peak throughput looks good, avg watt per token down ~18% vs baseline. Need to confirm kernel patch versions to reproduce.
devon-runtime: Nice. Which kernel branch + compiler flags? Also, did you run with prefix KV cache enabled?
kai-eng-ml: Do we have the sequence length distribution for that run? perf/W is sensitive to padding.
alex-voltedge: Branch: volt-rt-2026-03, flags: -O3 -march=native, kv cache ON for steady-state. Seq dist: 8k samples — I'll paste a small histogram in a sec.
bench-bot: Run 2026-03-21T14:02Z — metrics: p95 latency 38ms, tokens/sec 12.1k, power 2.8kW, perf_per_watt 4.32 tokens/J. Artifact: s3://voltedge-bench/rdw-20260321.tar.gz
sam-fieldeng: Can we reproduce without KV cache (cold-start) to show worst-case? Ops customers care about tail.
devon-runtime: Agreed — let's add cold-start sweep and a sustained-run (30m) to show thermal drift. Also need pinned driver versions; thermal throttling skews perf/W.
kai-eng-ml: For kernel tuning, we should capture: matmul tiling, fp16 vs int8 perf, and L2 prefetch settings. I can generate a small tuning matrix.
jon-partnerships: Tentative ask from VoltEdge: joint blog + marketplace listing callout. Marketing (Priya) — can you hold embargo/LS check?
priya-marketing: Yep. Need approvals: (1) VoltEdge legal signoff on data, (2) Redwood counsel ok with any performance claims. Also timeline — do we want to coordinate press or do a tech note first?
alex-voltedge: Prefer soft launch for customers first, then joint blog 2 weeks after public reproducible artifact. We require a 48h embargo buffer for partner product announcements.
jon-partnerships: Sounds reasonable. Action items: reproduce runs (Devon/Kai/Sam), produce reproducible artifact (container + runbook), get legal signoff (me + Priya), schedule joint blog (TBD).
devon-runtime: I'll create a reproducible image: tag redwood/bench:voltedge-20260321. It will include driver, kernel patch, and a run script. Example run: ```./run_bench.sh --model gpt-large --seq 1024 --duration 1800 --kv-cache on --profile power```
kai-eng-ml: I'll add the kernel tuning matrix as CSV and a small script to sweep matmul tile sizes. Example snippet: ```python tune.py --param tile=[32,64,128] --model gpt-large --power-sample 60```
sam-fieldeng: I'll run cold-starts and sustained runs in our lab this week. Posting logs to S3. Any specific telemetry we need? trace ids?
devon-runtime: Include: per-step power (1s), GPU temp, freq, p95 latency, and perf-per-watt. Also kernel dmesg captures in case of throttling.
priya-marketing: Please prepare short one-pager with topline numbers (peak perf/W, sustained perf/W, p95 latency) and a blunt summary of tradeoffs. I'll draft the blog outline after we get the one-pager.
jon-partnerships: Timeline proposal: reproduce + artifacts by Fri (3 business days), legal signoff Mon, joint blog target 2 weeks after. Can we hit that?
alex-voltedge: We can fast-track legal on our side. 3 days for reproducible artifact is OK.
devon-runtime: I'll start today. Will tag images and drop an SHA.
bench-bot: Artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/voltedge-repro/voltedge-20260321.sha256.txt
kai-eng-ml: Small note: when we publish, include our inference config (batching, kv cache, dynamic batching window). Publishing numbers without config leads to confusion.
priya-marketing: Agreed — we'll include a short config appendix. Legal may ask to include limits/footnotes.
jon-partnerships: Great. Who's owner for the runbook? Devon you can be owner, Kai co-owner for tuning docs, Sam for lab logs, Priya for comms, Alex for partner approvals. I'll file a shared Asana task.
devon-runtime: Owner ack. I'll put the runbook in the shared drive and copy the S3 artifact links.
alex-voltedge: Thanks — I'll ping our test lab for additional thermal sensor logs and share the NDA note.
priya-marketing: Quick ask — if we call out 'marketplace-ready', need confirmation from infra about packaging for marketplace image. Devon can you validate the image layout for marketplace listing?
devon-runtime: Yep — I'll validate packaging and manifest schema. If good, marketplace listing should be straightforward.
jon-partnerships: OK moving to calendar — short sync tomorrow 10am PT to confirm artifacts. If anything else pops up drop it here. :thumbsup:
